page_title.zh: 苏俊通 | 机器人加工与运动规划
page_title.en: Juntong Su | Robotic Machining and Motion Planning

description.zh: 苏俊通的学术主页，介绍多约束姿态运动规划、多模态加工性能感知和受限空间机器人铣削研究。
description.en: Academic homepage of Juntong Su. Research on multi-constraint posture and motion planning, multimodal machining performance sensing, and robotic milling in restricted spaces.

field.zh: 机器人加工与运动规划

affiliation.zh: 华中科技大学机械科学与工程学院
affiliation.en: School of Mechanical Science and Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

about.zh: 你好，我是苏俊通，在华中科技大学机械科学与工程学院做机器人加工研究。拿螺旋桨来说，相邻桨叶留给刀具的空间很有限。机器人只是换个姿态，刀具能不能到达、加工表面会是什么样，都可能跟着变。
about.en: Hi, I’m Juntong Su. I study robotic machining at the School of Mechanical Science and Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology. Propellers are a good example of the parts I work with. There’s little room between adjacent blades, and even a small change in posture can affect whether the cutter reaches the surface and how well it cuts.

about.zh: 我想弄清楚，力、振动等信号能告诉我们多少加工现场的情况，以及有多种约束时，怎样让机器人沿着刀路走得顺。这两个问题把我在加工感知和姿态运动规划上的工作串在了一起。
about.en: I’m interested in what force and vibration signals can tell us about cutting, and in how to plan smooth robot motion and tool orientation under multiple constraints. Those two questions connect my work on machining performance sensing and posture planning.

about.zh: 这个主页记录了我和合作者围绕这些问题做过的工作。如果你也对机器人加工或复杂曲面制造感兴趣，欢迎交流。
about.en: Here I share work my collaborators and I have done on these questions. If you’re interested in robotic machining or manufacturing complex surfaces, I’d be glad to exchange ideas.

description.zh: 沿既定刀路规划连续的刀具姿态和机器人运动，兼顾可达性、避碰、运动学限制与工艺要求。
description.en: Planning continuous tool orientations and robot motion along a prescribed toolpath while accounting for reachability, collision avoidance, kinematic limits, and machining requirements.

description.zh: 融合多源测量信号与加工机理模型，估计加工过程中的变形、误差和刀具磨损。
description.en: Integrating measurements from multiple sources with physical models to estimate deformation, machining error, and tool wear.

description.zh: 以螺旋桨等复杂曲面零件为主要应用对象，借助仿真基准与加工实验研究受限空间中的可达性、姿态调整与加工性能。
description.en: Studying access, orientation changes, and machining performance on propellers and other complex parts using simulation benchmarks and milling experiments.

title.zh: 受限空间机器人铣削的三维姿态规划研究：一种势网络架构
title.en: Investigation of the 3D-posture planning for space-restricted robotic milling: A potential network architecture

publications.venue: International Journal of Machine Tools and Manufacture

summary.zh: 用势网络统一表达姿态规划中的约束与目标，并构建考虑刀具与工件接触状态的姿态流形。方法在受限空间基准和螺旋桨加工任务中得到验证。
summary.en: A potential network brings planning constraints and objectives into one model. A posture manifold accounts for cutter–workpiece engagement. The approach was evaluated on a restricted-space benchmark and propeller milling tasks.

title.zh: PRIME：多约束机器人加工智能姿态轨迹规划的系统演化视角
title.en: PRIME: A systematic evolution perspective on intelligent posture-trajectory planning for robotic machining under multiple constraints

summary.zh: 通过梳理 222 项研究，将加工姿态视为沿刀路在约束下连续演化的规划变量，并归纳从冗余角优化到全自由度规划的四级能力框架。
summary.en: This review of 222 studies treats machining posture as a planning variable that evolves under constraints along the toolpath. It identifies four capability levels, from redundancy-angle optimization to full-degree-of-freedom planning.

title.zh: 融合多模态信息的可解释预知：物理知识驱动的时变刀具磨损预测
title.en: Towards interpretable foreknowledge with multimodal information fusion: Physical-knowledge inspired time-varying tool wear intelligent prediction

title.zh: 极端约束下曲面机器人铣削姿态主动调整：基于广义累积功指标的分治策略
title.en: Extremely constrained robotic milling posture active adjustment on curved surface: Divide and conquer strategy with index of generalized accumulative work

title.zh: RMDTs：面向加工过程与服务扩展的功能触发式机器人铣削数字孪生系统
title.en: RMDTs: Process-oriented function-triggered robotic milling digital twin system for service-expansion

title.en: Discrete-superposition mechanism of multiple constraints for robotic machining posture twin planning

title.en: A self-adaptive agent for flexible posture planning in robotic milling system

title.en: Feature fusion and distillation embedded sparse Bayesian learning model for in-situ foreknowledge of robotic machining errors

description.en: The repository provides benchmark geometry and setup notes for comparing posture feasibility and joint-motion smoothness in robot simulation.
